Passenger nearly sucked from plane after window shatters mid-air

A passenger on a Ryanair flight was reportedly pulled back into the cabin after being partially sucked out of the aircraft when a window shattered mid-air. Reports indicate that fellow passengers, including the man's wife, held onto him for several minutes to prevent him from being fully ejected. The incident occurred during a flight originating from Greece.
